product_profile.material: Clear glass flacon with polished silver-metal collar and opaque dark brown-black cylindrical cap
product_profile.color: Pale amber-yellow juice inside colorless glass, red-orange lettering, silver collar, near-black cap
product_profile.transparency: Body translucent with lightly tinted liquid; cap and collar opaque; glass edges read near-white
product_profile.illumination: Soft diffuse high-key studio light; gentle vertical highlights along glass shoulders and edges, specular streaks on metal collar, no hard cast shadow
product_profile.view: Straight-on front elevation at bottle mid-height, upright rectangular flacon with flat base and recessed foot notch
product_profile.integration_limits: Opaque cap/collar and bright near-white glass edge zones cannot transmit a new background; pale liquid is only faintly transmissive, so generated backdrops must sit behind the intact cutout silhouette and keep the label unmodified
